statistic: median of the monthly search-referred click totals; a month in which the article is absent counts as zero
source_floor: the dump omits any (referrer, article) pair under 10 clicks in the month, for reader privacy. An absent article is MEASURED as under ten, not unmeasured.
why: A count of people who searched, saw a result and clicked it, for this place, in this language. Read only to answer whether a CITY is sought in a language; never to establish that a FAMILY intent exists in a market.
known_limit: zhwiki is one Wikipedia for Traditional and Simplified Chinese and cannot be split, so a zh reading is evidence for zh-Hant only together with the Taiwanese market demand measured separately.
